text:
Fiona Chen: Hello everyone :wave: I'm Fiona, joining Platform from HKT. Laptop expected today. Quick q: who do I ping for MDM/VPN and access to the staging cluster? Also, is someone my buddy? Small brag: I bake mooncakes for Mid-Autumn and will share if anyone's local.

Benson Cho: Welcome Fiona! :tada: I'm Benson  your buddy for the first month. Ping me for pairing and onboarding questions. For access, tag @IT Support after MDM enrollment and @Lina Gomez for the onboarding checklist. I'll set up a 1:1 on day 2.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Fiona Chen! MDM invite sent to fiona.chen@example.com. Please enroll and confirm in this thread. If you don't receive the invite within 10 minutes reply here.

Fiona Chen: Thanks  I don't see the MDM email in inbox or spam yet. Also quick SSH question: do we use personal keys or company-managed ones for cluster access?

IT Support: Hi Fiona  we provision MDM-managed keypairs. Steps after MDM: generate an ed25519 key locally and upload the public key at https://id.redwood/internal-keys. Example:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "fiona@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```

Then open a ticket "staging-cluster access" with your employee ID. We'll approve once we see the key.

Lina Gomez: Added you to the onboarding doc and #platform. Buddy noted as Benson. I also sent the onboarding checklist and the intro circle invite for 09:30 HKT tomorrow.

Fiona Chen: Got the MDM invite this time and enrolling now  thanks. Employee ID is E-90012. Also yes please mooncakes will be in the intro hall if shipping permits :yum:.

Marta Ruiz: Hardware form link is https://redwood.it/hw-request  specify monitor size + dock. I've prefilled a 24" unless you'd prefer otherwise. If the laptop needs special drivers for your locale ping me.

Benson Cho: Pro tip: after uploading the key, wait ~2 minutes before requesting cluster access; the sync job needs a short window. Also I maintain a tiny dotfiles starter for macOS zsh users, will DM you the link.

OnboardingBot: MDM enrollment confirmed for Fiona Chen. Status: MDM enrolled, keys pending upload, hardware requested.

Fiona Chen: Uploaded the pubkey and opened ticket #6123 for staging access. Thanks everyone! Also fair warning: mooncake variety includes salted egg yolk so bring an open heart :grin:

IT Support: Key visible, approving staging-cluster access now. You should be able to SSH in within 15 minutes. If not, run `ssh -v` and paste output here.

Fiona Chen: Access works  can SSH to staging. Thanks for the warm welcome and the speedy help. Looking forward to meeting you all at the intro circle!"
